mapper.select: select count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(ead_amount),0) as ead_amount, ifnull(sum(el_avg),0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(el_downturn),0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure e where

select ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED') as scope_code, ifnull(c.industry_name,'未分类') as scope_name, count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct e.customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) as ead_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_avg),0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn),0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag=0 where group by ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED'), ifnull(c.industry_name,'未分类') order by ead_amount desc

select e.product_type as scope_code, e.product_type as scope_name, count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct e.customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) as ead_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_avg),0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn),0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure e where group by e.product_type order by ead_amount desc

select ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'UNASSIGNED') as scope_code, ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'未分配机构') as scope_name, count(*) as exposure_count, count(distinct e.customer_no) as customer_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) as ead_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_avg),0) as el_avg_amount, ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn),0) as el_downturn_amount from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag=0 where group by ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'UNASSIGNED'), ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'未分配机构') order by ead_amount desc

select id, dimension_type, scope_code, scope_name, metric_code, limit_amount, warning_ratio, owner, status, effective_date, expiry_date, created_at, updated_at from risk_portfolio_limit order by dimension_type, scope_name, metric_code
mapper.update: update risk_portfolio_limit set limit_amount=#{body.limit_amount}, warning_ratio=#{body.warning_ratio}, owner=#{body.owner}, status=#{body.status}, expiry_date=#{body.expiry_date} where id=#{id}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_portfolio_limit_snapshot (limit_id,data_date,actual_amount,portfolio_total_amount,utilization_ratio,concentration_ratio,monitor_status,evidence_json,captured_by) values (#{limit_id},#{data_date},#{actual_amount},#{portfolio_total_amount},#{utilization_ratio},#{concentration_ratio},#{monitor_status},#{evidence_json},#{captured_by}) on duplicate key update actual_amount=values(actual_amount),portfolio_total_amount=values(portfolio_total_amount),utilization_ratio=values(utilization_ratio),concentration_ratio=values(concentration_ratio),monitor_status=values(monitor_status),evidence_json=values(evidence_json),captured_by=values(captured_by),captured_at=current_timestamp
mapper.select: select s.limit_id,s.data_date,s.actual_amount,s.portfolio_total_amount,s.utilization_ratio,s.concentration_ratio,s.monitor_status,s.captured_at from risk_portfolio_limit_snapshot s join (select limit_id,max(data_date) as data_date from risk_portfolio_limit_snapshot group by limit_id) latest on latest.limit_id=s.limit_id and latest.data_date=s.data_date
select date_format(max(e.data_date),'%Y-%m-%d') from corporate_risk_exposure e where
mapper.sql: select ${segment} as segment_code, ${segment} as segment_name, count(*) as exposure_count, ifnull(sum(dd.debt_no is not null),0) as default_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) as ead_amount, case when sum(e.ead_amount)>0 then round(sum(e.ead_amount*e.pd)/sum(e.ead_amount),6) else 0 end as expected_pd, case when count(*)>0 then round(sum(dd.debt_no is not null)/count(*),6) else 0 end as observed_default_rate, case when sum(e.ead_amount)>0 then round(sum(e.ead_amount*e.lgd_avg)/sum(e.ead_amount),6) else 0 end as expected_lgd, case when sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then dd.default_exposure_amount else 0 end)>0 then round(sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then dd.loss_amount else 0 end)/sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then dd.default_exposure_amount else 0 end),6) else 0 end as observed_lgd, ifnull(sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then e.ead_amount else 0 end),0) as predicted_default_ead, ifnull(sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then dd.default_exposure_amount else 0 end),0) as observed_default_ead, ifnull(sum(e.el_avg),0) as predicted_el, ifnull(sum(case when dd.debt_no is not null then dd.loss_amount else 0 end),0) as observed_loss from corporate_risk_exposure e ${join} left join corporate_debt_default dd on dd.debt_no=e.debt_no and dd.deleted_flag=0 and dd.default_status='ACTIVE' where group by ${segment} order by ead_amount desc

property.name: join
property.value: left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag=0

mapper.select: select run_code from risk_model_backtest_run order by created_at desc,id desc limit 1
select * from risk_model_backtest_run where run_code=(select run_code from risk_model_backtest_run order by created_at desc,id desc limit 1) order by segment_type,ead_amount desc

select c.id as alert_case_id,c.customer_no,c.closed_at,c.risk_score as baseline_risk_score,c.closure_comment, ifnull(max(e.lgd_downturn),0) as current_lgd_downturn from risk_alert_case c left join corporate_risk_exposure e on e.customer_no=c.customer_no and e.deleted_flag=0 and e.exposure_status='ACTIVE' where c.alert_state='RESOLVED' and c.closed_at is not null group by c.id,c.customer_no,c.closed_at,c.risk_score,c.closure_comment
mapper.insert: insert into risk_alert_effectiveness_snapshot (alert_case_id,evaluation_date,evaluation_window_days,closed_at,baseline_risk_score,current_risk_score,score_delta,current_pd,current_lgd_downturn,overdue_count,debt_default_count,effectiveness_status,conclusion,evaluated_by) values (#{alert_case_id},#{evaluation_date},#{evaluation_window_days},#{closed_at},#{baseline_risk_score},#{current_risk_score},#{score_delta},#{current_pd},#{current_lgd_downturn},#{overdue_count},#{debt_default_count},#{effectiveness_status},#{conclusion},#{evaluated_by}) on duplicate key update current_risk_score=values(current_risk_score),score_delta=values(score_delta),current_pd=values(current_pd),current_lgd_downturn=values(current_lgd_downturn),overdue_count=values(overdue_count),debt_default_count=values(debt_default_count),effectiveness_status=values(effectiveness_status),conclusion=values(conclusion),evaluated_by=values(evaluated_by)
mapper.select: select s.*,c.customer_no,c.priority,c.closure_comment from risk_alert_effectiveness_snapshot s join risk_alert_case c on c.id=s.alert_case_id where s.evaluation_date=(select max(evaluation_date) from risk_alert_effectiveness_snapshot) order by s.effectiveness_status,s.score_delta

select 'INDUSTRY' dimension_type,ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED') scope_code, round(sum(a.apply_amount*0.35),2) reserved_amount,count(*) application_count from corporate_credit_application a join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=a.customer_no_snapshot and c.deleted_flag=0 where a.deleted_flag=0 and a.application_status='APPROVED' group by ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED') union all select 'PRODUCT',a.product_type,round(sum(a.apply_amount*0.35),2),count(*) from corporate_credit_application a where a.deleted_flag=0 and a.application_status='APPROVED' group by a.product_type union all select 'ORGANIZATION',ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'UNASSIGNED'),round(sum(a.apply_amount*0.35),2),count(*) from corporate_credit_application a join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=a.customer_no_snapshot and c.deleted_flag=0 where a.deleted_flag=0 and a.application_status='APPROVED' group by ifnull(c.owner_org_name,'UNASSIGNED')
select * from risk_stress_scenario_definition where status='ENABLED' order by id
select * from risk_stress_scenario_definition where scenario_code=#{scenarioCode} and status='ENABLED' limit 1

select ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED') segment_code,ifnull(c.industry_name,'未分类') segment_name, count(*) exposure_count,count(distinct e.customer_no) customer_count,sum(e.ead_amount) base_ead, sum(e.el_downturn) base_el,sum(e.collateral_value) collateral_value, case when sum(e.ead_amount)>0 then sum(e.ead_amount*e.pd)/sum(e.ead_amount) else 0 end weighted_pd, case when sum(e.ead_amount)>0 then sum(e.ead_amount*e.lgd_downturn)/sum(e.ead_amount) else 0 end weighted_lgd from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=e.customer_no and c.deleted_flag=0 where group by ifnull(c.industry_name,'UNCLASSIFIED'),ifnull(c.industry_name,'未分类') order by base_ead desc

select r.*,s.scenario_name,s.severity from risk_portfolio_stress_result r join risk_stress_scenario_definition s on s.scenario_code=r.scenario_code where r.run_code=(select run_code from risk_portfolio_stress_result order by created_at desc,id desc limit 1) order by incremental_loss desc

select g.group_code,g.group_name,g.controller_customer_no,g.risk_appetite_amount,g.owner_org_name, count(distinct m.customer_no) member_count,count(distinct e.exposure_no) exposure_count, ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) ead_amount,ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn),0) el_downturn_amount, ifnull(sum(e.collateral_value),0) collateral_value,ifnull(sum(e.overdue_days>0),0) overdue_count, ifnull(sum(e.default_flag=1),0) default_count, case when g.risk_appetite_amount>0 then ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0)/g.risk_appetite_amount else 0 end appetite_utilization, case when ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0)>0 then ifnull(sum(e.collateral_value),0)/sum(e.ead_amount) else 0 end collateral_coverage from risk_customer_group g join risk_customer_group_member m on m.group_id=g.id left join corporate_risk_exposure e on e.customer_no=m.customer_no and e.deleted_flag=0 and e.exposure_status='ACTIVE' where g.status='ACTIVE' group by g.id,g.group_code,g.group_name,g.controller_customer_no,g.risk_appetite_amount,g.owner_org_name order by ead_amount desc

select g.group_code,m.customer_no,max(c.customer_name) customer_name,m.relationship_type,m.ownership_ratio,m.guarantee_flag, count(distinct e.exposure_no) exposure_count,ifnull(sum(e.ead_amount),0) ead_amount,ifnull(sum(e.el_downturn),0) el_downturn_amount, ifnull(sum(e.overdue_days>0),0) overdue_count,ifnull(sum(e.default_flag=1),0) default_count,max(e.risk_level) risk_level from risk_customer_group g join risk_customer_group_member m on m.group_id=g.id left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no=m.customer_no and c.deleted_flag=0 left join corporate_risk_exposure e on e.customer_no=m.customer_no and e.deleted_flag=0 and e.exposure_status='ACTIVE' where g.group_code=#{groupCode} group by g.group_code,m.customer_no,m.relationship_type,m.ownership_ratio,m.guarantee_flag order by ead_amount desc

select v.id,v.version_code,v.version_name,v.status,v.rule_count,v.created_by,v.submitted_by,v.approved_by, v.simulated_at,v.submitted_at,v.approved_at,v.published_at,v.created_at, (select count(*) from risk_model_approval_log l where l.version_id=v.id) approval_action_count, case when v.simulated_at is null then '待模拟' when v.submitted_at is null then '待提交' when v.approved_at is null then '待审批' when v.published_at is null then '待发布' else '运行监控' end lifecycle_stage from risk_model_version v order by v.created_at desc limit 20

select count(*) version_total,sum(status='PUBLISHED') published_count,sum(status='DRAFT') draft_count, sum(status='PENDING_APPROVAL') pending_approval_count,sum(status='APPROVED') approved_pending_publish_count, (select count(*) from risk_model_backtest_run where run_code=(select run_code from risk_model_backtest_run order by created_at desc limit 1) and calibration_status='RECALIBRATE') recalibrate_segment_count, (select average_risk_score from risk_model_monitor_snapshot order by snapshot_date desc,id desc limit 1) latest_average_risk_score, (select snapshot_date from risk_model_monitor_snapshot order by snapshot_date desc,id desc limit 1) latest_monitor_date from risk_model_version

select count(*) evaluated_count,sum(effectiveness_status='EFFECTIVE') effective_count, sum(effectiveness_status='PARTIAL') partial_count,sum(effectiveness_status='INEFFECTIVE') ineffective_count, sum(effectiveness_status='OBSERVING') observing_count, case when count(*)>0 then round(sum(effectiveness_status='EFFECTIVE')/count(*),6) else 0 end effective_rate, case when count(*)>0 then round(sum(effectiveness_status in ('EFFECTIVE','PARTIAL'))/count(*),6) else 0 end improvement_rate, case when count(*)>0 then round(avg(baseline_risk_score-current_risk_score),2) else 0 end average_score_improvement, case when count(*)>0 then round(sum(effectiveness_status='INEFFECTIVE')/count(*),6) else 0 end ineffective_rate from risk_alert_effectiveness_snapshot where evaluation_date=(select max(evaluation_date) from risk_alert_effectiveness_snapshot)
select username,workspace_role,default_tab,density_mode,visible_modules_json,updated_at from risk_user_workbench_preference where username=#{username}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_user_workbench_preference (username,workspace_role,default_tab,density_mode,visible_modules_json,updated_by) values (#{username},#{workspace_role},#{default_tab},#{density_mode},#{visible_modules_json},#{updated_by}) on duplicate key update workspace_role=values(workspace_role),default_tab=values(default_tab),density_mode=values(density_mode), visible_modules_json=values(visible_modules_json),updated_by=values(updated_by),updated_at=current_timestamp
